description: Plotting and export utilities for density tables, atlas-region summaries, mask point clouds, brainrender inputs, and vessel renderings.

entrypoints.description: Summarize Level_* sheets from a per-region density Excel workbook into default coarse Allen brain regions, then save atlas-order and value-sorted bar plots.
prerequisites: Input Excel must be produced by region_signal_analysis_zarr_graph.py or have compatible Level_* sheets
Level_* sheets must include a Name column and the selected metric column
Allen region CSV must be available; defaults to pipeline_modules/registration/Region_Csv_Rev1_updated.CSV

cfg.description: Allen region CSV containing id, name, and structure_id_path

metric.description: Column from the Level_* sheets to aggregate and plot

output_prefix.description: Output path prefix; defaults to input Excel path without suffix

common_commands.description: Plot coarse-region cFos voxel density for a sample directory containing <sample_dir_name>_density_result.xlsx
common_commands.powershell: python S:\Yifu\pipeline_modules\visualization\coarse_region_metric_plot.py --input_excel "S:\Arivis_Analysis\YF2026032001zzj_cfos\tbi\tbi_density_result.xlsx" --metric "Voxel Density" --title "TBI cFos coarse region density" --ylabel "cFos voxel density" --output_prefix "S:\Arivis_Analysis\YF2026032001zzj_cfos\tbi\tbi_cfos_density"

entrypoints.description: Find density Excel workbooks in direct child sample folders, summarize them into default coarse Allen brain regions, and draw grouped bar plots comparing samples.
prerequisites: Each direct child folder under root_dir is treated as a sample_dir
Each sample_dir should contain at least one *.xlsx file with density in the filename
Density workbooks must contain Level_* sheets with Name and selected metric columns

common_commands.description: Compare coarse-region voxel density across all sample folders under a root folder

entrypoints.description: Find density Excel workbooks in exactly two child sample folders, compare Level_6 count metrics, and plot the top absolute log(A/B) region differences.
prerequisites: root_dir must contain exactly two child sample_dir folders with density Excel workbooks
Density workbooks must contain a Level_6 sheet with Name and selected metric columns

root_dir.description: Folder containing exactly two sample_dir child folders

pseudocount.description: Added to both counts before computing log ratio

min_count.description: Minimum combined count across both samples required before ranking

rank_by.description: Ranking score for selecting top regions; weighted_log_ratio uses abs(log_ratio) * log1p(countA + countB)

common_commands.description: Compare top Level_6 signal-count differences between two sample folders

entrypoints.description: Warp a sample-space mask into atlas space, cache the atlas-space volume/points, and render 3D or 2D heatmaps.
prerequisites: sample_dir should contain <signal_ch>_mask.zarr, <register_ch>_downsample/volume.nii.gz, and transforms/
Atlas reference files should exist under data/reference/
For repeated runs, the cached atlas-space volume can be reused from sample_dir/visualization/<sample>_heatmap3d_volume.tiff

sample_dir.description: Sample directory used by --mode sample-stack. Most defaults are resolved from here.

input.description: Atlas-space TIFF volume for --mode stack/atlas-slice, or explicit mask_zarr for --mode sample-stack

output.description: Output heatmap path. sample-stack defaults to sample_dir/visualization/<sample>_heatmap3d_stack.tiff

sigma.description: 3D Gaussian smoothing strength for signal rendering. For broader, more continuous cFos-style heatmaps, sigma around 10 can produce the desired effect.

alpha.description: Signal intensity scaling factor after smoothing

display_vmax.description: Optional normalization ceiling used with --normalize to brighten or compress the heatmap range

summary_json.description: Heatmap summary JSON written next to the output heatmap

common_commands.description: Generate a cached atlas-space volume plus 3D heatmap from a sample directory
Render a broader, redder 3D heatmap using stronger smoothing
Render a 2D coronal AP slice from the cached atlas-space volume

entrypoints.description: Warp a sample-space mask Zarr into Allen atlas space and export atlas-space point CSV (and optional binary atlas TIFF volume). Used by render_points_brainrender.py and heatmap.py when cached atlas outputs are missing.
prerequisites: sample_dir should contain <signal_ch>_mask.zarr, <register_ch>_downsample/volume.nii.gz, and registration transforms
Atlas reference image must match the registration atlas
Run in the yifu/registration environment (ANTsPy required)

sample_dir.description: Sample root; resolves mask_zarr and transforms when explicit paths are omitted

resolution_xyz.description: Input mask voxel size in microns as x,y,z

max_points.description: Random cap on exported atlas points; 0 disables cap

atlas_volume_tiff.description: Optional atlas-space mask TIFF when --output_volume is set

summary_json.description: Metadata JSON written next to atlas volume export

guide.summary: Warp sample-space mask Zarr to Allen atlas space and export points.csv. Called automatically by render_points_brainrender when cached atlas outputs are missing.
points_csv_fallback_order: Run this script from mask zarr (full warp)

entrypoints.description: Render atlas-space punctate signals as colored spheres inside a transparent Allen standard brain. Supports custom region-group meshes, interactive camera export, and per-group batch screenshots.
prerequisites: Atlas-space points CSV must exist or be generatable via --sample_dir
BrainGlobe atlas allen_mouse_25um must be downloaded in the napari/brainrender environment
On Windows, set PYTHONPATH to the repo root before running
Default region groups: config/region_groups.json

sample_dir.description: Sample root; auto-resolves points.csv and default output paths under sample_dir/visualization/

points_csv.description: Atlas-space point CSV; defaults to sample_dir/visualization/points.csv when --sample_dir is set

force_warp.description: Regenerate atlas-space points even if CSV exists

region_groups.description: Named atlas region groups with acronyms and colors

screenshot_per_group.description: Save one PNG per selected group using the same camera

output_dir.description: Output directory for --screenshot_per_group; defaults to sample_dir/visualization/brainrender

camera_view.description: Load camera JSON; omit path to use sample_dir/visualization/{sample}_brainrender_view.json

export_camera_view.description: Interactive camera export mode; press V in viewer to save JSON

output.description: Single PNG output; omit to open interactive viewer

entrypoints.description: Render kimimaro SWC skeleton branches as smooth 3D spline curves colored by mean vessel diameter, with optional branch-point spheres.
prerequisites: Input must be a directory of .swc files from kimimaro_reconstruction.py --save_swc
Run in an environment with pyvista and matplotlib

max_files.description: Limit loaded SWC files; 0 means all

output.description: Save screenshot instead of opening interactive viewer

save_on_close.description: Interactive mode: press S in viewer to save current view

common_commands.description: Quick interactive preview of SWC skeleton branches

guide.summary: Render SWC skeleton files as smooth 3D branch curves with red branch-point spheres. Each branch between two non-degree-2 nodes is a smooth spline colored by mean vessel diameter, with a lower-right colorbar.

input.format: Directory of .swc files (one per skeleton/connected component)
input.swc_line_format: id type x y z radius parent

guide.pipeline_position: binary mask Zarr → kimimaro_reconstruction.py --save_skeleton --save_swc → swc/ → render_vessels_pyvista.py --swc_dir swc/

smoothing_pipeline.name: min_spacing filter
smoothing_pipeline.description: Remove control points closer than min_spacing um; eliminates redundant dense vertices

smoothing_pipeline.name: moving-average smooth
smoothing_pipeline.description: Sliding window (smooth_window) on interior points; endpoints preserved

smoothing_pipeline.name: spline interpolation
smoothing_pipeline.description: pv.Spline through cleaned points; n = len(points) * spline_factor

output_modes.interactive: Default — PyVista 3D viewer; rotate/zoom with mouse. Press S to save view when save_on_close/interactive_output set.

notes: SWC radius values control branch color only; visual tube width is uniform via --line_width
Branch points = nodes with more than one child in SWC tree
Each SWC file = one skeleton; branch IDs globally unique across loaded files
For best results run kimimaro_reconstruction.py with --prune_spurs_max_length_um 5.0
